summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the new features batch: historical_minutes (create/edit/list), Tuesday bonus_payday + Monday kgen_payday on /admin/week and /me/dashboard (including weeks[] with status current/future, day_minutes{}), member PayCalendar (data-tone kgen/bonus/cycle/future/paid/pending, calendar-day-YYYY-MM-DD + calendar-minutes-YYYY-MM-DD, prev/next week + month navigation with focus-week change, calendar-day-popover swapping titles per day, calendar-legend), historical minutes admin form (worker-historical-input-add/-edit accepts digits only, live '= Xh Ym' conversion, worker-historical-<id> badge in list), theme-toggle-button on /login /panel /admin (html.dark + localStorage.theme=dark, persists across reload, toggles back to light), admin regression (payout-export-card, Rankings/Gráfico/Miembros/Registros tabs). All 23 pytest cases pass (2 skipped: stale Prueba Maria math test and mark/unmark payments — no payable worker after cleanup). Cleaned DB at end: only admin Wuilber remains, no entries, no payments.

issues: Recharts warning 'width(-1) and height(-1)' still logged on first paint when tab/section is hidden — non-blocking, same as iteration_1
Radix warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — non-blocking a11y

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription to WorkerForm and any other admin dialog to remove Radix aria warning.
(Optional) Give charts an explicit min-height to silence Recharts (-1) warning on first render.
critical_code_review_comments: PayCalendar computes `focusEnd` with a regex+setDate fallback that is dead-code when weeks[] contains the focus week; simplify to `shiftWeek(focusWeek, 6)` or derive weekday-end via new Date + 6 days for readability.

ThemeToggle is a self-contained component but reads localStorage synchronously in useState initializer — App.js also applies `.dark` at module top for pre-hydration. Good pattern, but the two writers could drift; consider a shared hook.

server.py still uses `date.today()` (server-timezone) for week boundaries and daily-duplicate guard; a worker recording near midnight local time can hit unexpected 409s. Consider ZoneInfo('America/Guatemala').

me_dashboard.weeks[] only includes weeks that have entries or the current/next week; a closed-and-paid week without entries won't appear, which is fine for empty data but means PayCalendar can't render 'paid' tone for such history. Acceptable given seed rules.
No brute-force lockout on /auth/login (4-digit PIN); still noted from iteration_1.
historical_minutes has no explicit upper bound; UI caps at 8 digits (~99,999,999 min). Backend accepts any non-negative int — consider a sane cap (e.g. 10 years * 60*24*365).
